title: A single Sky Forum category is the canonical disclosure channel for every Osero governance obligation
content:
A.6.1.1.7.3.1.1 states simply: "Osero uses the Sky Forum for governance-related discussion. Posts should use the 'Osero Prime' category."

Read alone this is a housekeeping convention. Read against the rest of the Artifact it is the endpoint of every disclosure duty Osero has. Root Edit proposals must be posted there (A.6.1.1.7.2.2.2.2.1.2.1.1). The Operational Facilitator announces alignment and feasibility findings there (.1.3). Transitional submissions with cryptographic proof of holdings go there (.1.1.1). Emergency Root Edit reasoning is announced there (.2.3.1). Operational GovOps must explain a blocked rebate distribution there (A.6.1.1.7.2.3.2.2.1.2.1.3).

Concentrating everything in one named category has a real benefit: a single feed constitutes the complete public record of Osero governance, so no interested party has to know in advance where to look, and an obligation to "post publicly" is unambiguous about where.

The dependency is equally real. The Artifact's transparency guarantees are all discharged through a category on a forum the Agent does not operate. Availability, moderation and archival of that venue are outside the governed text, and the Artifact specifies no fallback if it becomes unavailable — the same class of external dependency as the GitHub repository currently holding the Atlas text (A.6.1.1.7.2.2.2.2.1.2.1.5.1).
description: "Osero Prime" carries proposal submissions, Facilitator findings, blocked rebate explanations and emergency announcements, so one venue concentrates all mandated transparency.
